name: FusedRecurrentKdaFwd

g.description: Per-channel log decay [B, T, HV, K] (<= 0)

beta.description: Gate coefficient [B, T, HV, V] in (0, 1)

initial_state.description: Initial state [N, HV, V, K], optional

inplace_final_state.description: Whether to write final state in place (default True)

ssm_state_indices.description: State slot indices per sequence, optional

use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel.description: Apply L2 norm to q/k before recurrence

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
def run(q, k, v, g, beta, scale, initial_state=None,
            inplace_final_state=True, cu_seqlens=None,
            ssm_state_indices=None, num_accepted_tokens=None,
            use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel=False):
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    B, T, H, K = k.shape
    HV, V = v.shape[2], v.shape[-1]
    G = HV // H
    q_f, k_f, v_f = q.float(), k.float(), v.float()
    g_f, beta_f = g.float(), beta.float()
    if initial_state is None:
        if cu_seqlens is None:
            num_states = B
        else:
            num_states = (len(cu_seqlens) - 1) if ssm_state_indices is None \
                else (int(ssm_state_indices.max().item()) + 1)
        initial_state = torch.zeros(num_states, HV, V, K, dtype=v.dtype, device=v.device)
    else:
        num_states = initial_state.shape[0]
        target_states = B if cu_seqlens is None else (len(cu_seqlens) - 1)
        if num_states < target_states:
            repeat = (target_states + num_states - 1) // num_states
            initial_state = initial_state.repeat(
                repeat, *(1 for _ in range(initial_state.ndim - 1)))[:target_states]
    if use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel:
        q_f = F.normalize(q_f, p=2, dim=-1)
        k_f = F.normalize(k_f, p=2, dim=-1)
    k_f = k_f * scale
    q_flat = q_f.reshape(B * T, H, K)
    k_flat = k_f.reshape(B * T, H, K)
    v_flat = v_f.reshape(B * T, HV, V)
    g_flat = g_f.reshape(B * T, HV, -1)
    beta_flat = beta_f.reshape(B * T, HV, -1)
    o_flat = torch.zeros(B * T, HV, V, dtype=torch.float32, device=v.device)
    if cu_seqlens is None:
        bounds = [(b * T, (b + 1) * T) for b in range(B)]
        slots = list(range(B))
    else:
        cu = cu_seqlens.tolist()
        bounds = [(cu[n], cu[n + 1]) for n in range(len(cu) - 1)]
        slots = list(range(len(cu) - 1)) if ssm_state_indices is None else ssm_state_indices.tolist()
    final_state = initial_state.clone()
    head_map = torch.arange(HV, device=v.device) // G
    for n, (t0, t1) in enumerate(bounds):
        slot = slots[n]
        S = initial_state[slot].float()
        accepted = None if num_accepted_tokens is None else int(num_accepted_tokens[n])
        for t in range(t0, t1):
            k_t = k_flat[t, head_map]
            q_t = q_flat[t, head_map]
            v_new = v_flat[t] - torch.einsum('hvk,hk->hv', S, k_t)
            v_new = v_new * beta_flat[t]
            S = S * torch.exp(g_flat[t]).unsqueeze(1) + v_new.unsqueeze(-1) * k_t.unsqueeze(1)
            o_flat[t] = torch.einsum('hvk,hk->hv', S, q_t)
            if accepted is not None and (t - t0 + 1) == accepted:
                final_state[slot] = S.to(initial_state.dtype)
        if accepted is None:
            final_state[slot] = S.to(initial_state.dtype)
    return o_flat.reshape(v.shape).to(v.dtype), final_state

import zlib

_DTYPE_CODE = {0: torch.float16, 1: torch.bfloat16, 2: torch.float32}


def make_inputs(axes, device):
    """Custom input generator (custom_inputs_entrypoint).

    Deterministic per case: RNG is reseeded from the axes dict so repeated
    calls (once per custom input) produce identical tensors. Tensors are
    generated on CPU; the evaluator moves them to the target device.
    Scalars are returned as plain Python values (workloads may not mix
    custom and non-custom inputs, so scale / use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel are
    produced here too).

    axes:
        B, T, H, K, HV, V   q/k [B,T,H,K], v [B,T,HV,V], g [B,T,HV,K], beta [B,T,HV,V]
        DT        dtype code for q/k/v/beta (0=fp16, 1=bf16, 2=fp32)
        DTG       dtype code for g
        SCALE_U   scale * 1e6 as int
        HAS_INIT  1 if initial_state is present
        N, DTI    initial_state [N,HV,V,K] dtype code (only when HAS_INIT=1)
        L2        1 if use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel input is present (value True)
    """
    torch.manual_seed(zlib.crc32(repr(sorted(axes.items())).encode()) & 0x7FFFFFFF)
    B, T, H, K = axes["B"], axes["T"], axes["H"], axes["K"]
    HV, V = axes["HV"], axes["V"]
    dt = _DTYPE_CODE[axes["DT"]]
    dtg = _DTYPE_CODE[axes["DTG"]]

    def mixed_scaled(shape, dtype):
        # 标准 mixed 分布 (50% U(-5,5) + 50% N(mu,sigma)) 再乘 0.2 收紧
        if torch.rand(1).item() < 0.5:
            t = torch.empty(shape, dtype=dtype).uniform_(-5.0, 5.0)
        else:
            mu = float(torch.empty(1).uniform_(-5.0, 5.0).item())
            sigma = float(torch.empty(1).uniform_(0.1, 2.0).item())
            t = torch.normal(mu, sigma, shape, dtype=dtype)
        return t * 0.2

    q = mixed_scaled([B, T, H, K], dt)
    k = mixed_scaled([B, T, H, K], dt)
    v = mixed_scaled([B, T, HV, V], dt)
    # g 是逐通道 log 衰减，必须 <= 0；限制在 [-8, -0.5] 避免状态累乘发散
    g = -torch.empty([B, T, HV, K], dtype=dtg).uniform_(0.5, 8.0)
    # beta 物理含义是 sigmoid 门控系数，取值 (0, 1)
    beta = torch.empty([B, T, HV, V], dtype=dt).uniform_(0.0, 1.0)
    out = {"q": q, "k": k, "v": v, "g": g, "beta": beta,
           "scale": axes["SCALE_U"] / 1e6}
    if axes.get("HAS_INIT", 0):
        out["initial_state"] = mixed_scaled(
            [axes["N"], HV, V, K], _DTYPE_CODE[axes["DTI"]])
    if axes.get("L2", 0):
        out["use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel"] = True
    return out
description:
Model that performs fused recurrent KDA (gated delta rule) forward computation.
    fused_recurrent_kda_fwd(q, k, v, g, beta, scale, initial_state, ...)
        -> (o, final_state)

    torch 原生小算子拼接参考实现(与 Triton kernel 逐 token 递归语义一致):
        q_t = l2norm(q_t); k_t = l2norm(k_t)   # 可选, use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel
        k_t = k_t * scale
        v_new = (v_t - S @ k_t) * beta_t       # S: [V, K]; beta: 标量/头 或 逐通道 [V]
        S = S * exp(g_t) + v_new ⊗ k_t         # KDA: g_t 为逐通道 log 衰减 [K]
        o_t = S @ q_t                          # [V]
    每条序列的 S 从 initial_state[ssm_state_indices[n]] 载入,
    在序列末尾(或 num_accepted_tokens 指定的已接受 token 处)写回 final_state。
    注: kernel 侧 o = empty_like(k), 隐含约束 H == HV 且 K == V, case 按此生成。 Inputs are generated by make_inputs (custom_inputs_entrypoint): q/k/v/initial_state = standard mixed * 0.2, g = -uniform(0.5, 8), beta = uniform(0, 1).
